correctness.rationale: At beta=r1=q+h1 (R0=1), the source auxiliary Ic0=b(r1-beta)/(beta-r0)=0, contrary to its feasible positive Ic statement. Recomputed lower normal flow X1sigma=-r1 Ic^2/(S+Ic)<0. Simplified upper tangency to Sc2=(r0 Ic+b r1)/Delta; upper field is positive for S>Sc2, so the sliding ray is repulsing. The source sliding field -mu(S-Ss), Ss=(Lambda-q Ic)/mu, has a feasible zero exactly when Lambda Delta - mu b r1 >= Ic(q Delta+mu r0). With a positive numerator this yields 0<Ic<=Ic-dagger, and strict interior pseudo-saddles for Ic<Ic-dagger; at equality it is tangency. Independent Fraction substitutions for exact witness produce Ic-dagger=1597/150, Sc2=53/20, Ss=45, normal values -27/20 and 2541/340, population total 50<80.
residual_risks: Critical surface beta=r1 only; endpoint is tangency, not an interior pseudo-saddle; genuine biological region requires positivity and bounded population.
